implemented: Added a deterministic serializer for the bounded YAML scalar, sequence and mapping value model, with safe quoted strings, keys, finite numbers and configurable block indentation or flow style.
Added typed inline Markdown property edits that use flow YAML and preserve existing inline comments and source ordering while refusing nested block properties and literal/folded block scalars.
Corrected MarkdownProperty.rawValue and edit spans to exclude inline comments, improving tag/property consumers without touching unrelated source bytes.
limitations: This is an explicit bounded serializer, not full YAML dialect coverage; aliases, anchors, tags, multiline scalars and other unsupported constructs remain source-only and are not rewritten.
Typed property editing is intentionally inline-only; nested block property editing, reference Obsidian round trips and cross-platform visible validation remain pending.
The application continues to report 165 mandatory acceptance rows not release-passing; this increment does not claim release readiness.
